services.name: Family Draw: Weekly Drawing Class
services.desc: Come draw together after school, following creative prompts and exploring different art materials! Past classes included projects using charcoal, pencil, watercolor, ink, colored pencils, and more! A great way to connect as a family and make memories along with your art. Ages/Level: Designed for ages 4+ to come create imaginatively with their families! All levels of experience are welcome Cost, which includes all materials: $10 per participant per class. If you are an adult participating in the class with your child, you will also need to pay for yourself. About teaching artist JJ Jorgenson: JJ Jorgenson is a wildlife artist and travel sketcher based in Los Angeles. JJ’s creative pursuits
